- Weather: the humidity of each day in Next days is a blue drop and the percent in the middle of the row (it stood left of the high and low).
- Game Hub CD shelf: Back puts the open case back in the rack (it left the whole app); the search no longer takes games off the shelf (a single case repeated, and the cases vanished on every rebuild): the rack slides to the first game that matches while you type, and the search opens with the keyboard up.
- Keyboard: Notes opens inside the keyboard (the notes to pick from, + saves the text of the field as a note, Open for the app); the new text tools join the ⋮ menu.
- Keyboard: a number is kept after it was typed three times (not at once), and the shorter and the longer form of one number are one entry (the full number typed last stays).
- Keyboard, Google Keyboard look: pill-shaped keys, and a See-through option (off by default; keys, function keys and board take an alpha, with a pale edge).
- Game Hub CD shelf: the search slides the rack to the game by the shorter way round (the rack is endless), and the Play / Details buttons follow the case in the slot after it has wrapped round.
- Update windows: the window before an update shows only the new release's own notes (not the file list), and the window after an update lists only this version's notes (it had kept the notes of many old versions, one under the other).
- Keyboard: a Block Circle to Search switch (off by default, in Pick your features): while the keyboard is up its window is hidden from screen capture so the long press on the home bar cannot read the screen (screenshots show the keyboard black; not every phone honours it).
- Files: the Home page is gone: the app opens on Browse and the bottom bar has Browse, Share, Search and More (Back from another tab goes to Browse).
- Music: the Played chip stays on one line (the chip row scrolls); the waveform seek bar is not drawn while the keyboard is up (it showed over the lyrics search window).
- Music: fixed a crash after a Bluetooth connect (the playback service was started with nothing to play and never showed its card: the system ended the app); the auto start now begins only when a queue and volume exist, and the service stops itself when nothing plays.
- Files: its process (:files) ends 1.5 seconds after the last Files window is closed (it stayed in the background with its memory).
- Video: the small window's buttons are Previous, Play / Pause and Next (they change the episode) for a series; one video keeps back and forward 10 s. A 'Next episode' pill shows in the last 90 seconds of an episode of a series (as the intro and recap pills).
- Keyboard, number pad: hold 4 types a full stop, hold 5 a comma.
- Live updates (Android 16): YouTube (YTX) downloads show a status bar notification with the percent; compressing and file copy / move jobs ask to be promoted too.
- Toolkit: the Spin the bottle tile turns on the tile itself, three turns that slow down and stop at the angle that came up.
- YouTube (YTX): History has an All link that opens the whole history as a page with a search box (title or channel); Music: the History chip is the whole page of everything played, searched with the box above.
- Files: a file that arrives in the folder from another app (a download) shows by itself within two seconds.
- Code: the editor ground is black always (the AMOLED switch is gone) and see-through in the Windows 11 look.
- Notification badges: the channels an older version made with the icon badge on are removed once and made again without it, so no extra app wears the dot (alarm channels are left alone).
- Code: the tools under the title are icons (wrap, fold block, fold all, unfold all, smaller, larger) instead of words.
- File picker: a file of a kind the system does not know (a model file) is no longer greyed out when the asking app accepts any binary file.
- Keyboard and every screen of Pulse: the App lock's window scan asked each window's root on the main thread, and when the other app was busy that froze Pulse (and the keyboard, which shares the thread) for up to a second; it now asks on its own thread.
- Game Hub CD shelf: a game looked for and not found is not looked for again for a week, and nothing starts (no notification) when there is nothing new to look for; the Look for covers button asks again at once.
- Files: the crawl of the whole phone for search runs at background priority.
- ArtCraft: no APK is downloaded for an icon any more (it used to download the whole APK of each app on its own and keep it); the APKs an older version left are deleted once. An APK comes only from its Download button.
- Store: extras no longer update by themselves in the background; the update waits to be pressed. Old Pulse update APKs in Download/Pulse/Updates are deleted.
- Files: a search page of its own (round button at the bottom right): the whole phone is searched by a Rust walk (several threads, stops at the limit; a Kotlin walk when the library is missing) while typing, with the searches typed before as a history.
- Files selection bar: Rename and Properties keep their places for several files (dimmed) and Delete is always the second from the right.
- Files: several picked files can be renamed at once (a new name with numbers, and a word found and replaced in each name; the extension stays); the Rename icon stays lit for several.
- Keyboard: a pasted stack of pictures is not carried into the stack of the next picture (the old one stayed at the top right).
- Performance log: a thread that takes more than 60% of a core also writes the stacks of the running threads of that name (BUSY THREAD), so a hot loop in the background shows its code.
- Files > Apps: a search box (name or package); a broom icon empties the caches of the picked apps (with root the cache folders, with Shizuku the system trims the caches; the apps and their data stay), as SD Maid's app cleaner does.
- App details: an activity, service or receiver the app keeps private is started through the shell (am) when root or Shizuku is on, instead of failing with 'not exported'.
- Files file-type lists (APK, pictures, ...): sort chips (size, name, date, path), the full folder path and the date on each row, a slide after a long press picks every row it passes, and a file the system refuses to delete is removed by root or Shizuku's shell.
- Files: a long press on a second row picks the rows between only when it follows the last pick within two seconds; after a longer pause it starts a new pick (that row alone).
- Music (Poweramp look): while the now playing sheet is pulled, the page under it (Library, Search) keeps its blurred cover background instead of turning plain black.
- Music, YouTube Music page: under the chips a Speed dial (the songs played last, as covers) and Suggestions (from the taste log and the radio) scroll with the list.
- Video small window (PiP): a series has previous, back 10 s, play / pause, forward 10 s and next when the system's window takes five buttons (with three it keeps previous / play / next; one video keeps back 10 s / play / forward 10 s).
